transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me a little bit about what has been bothering you and what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I'm constantly being watched and followed by people, and it's making me really anxious. I can just feel them monitoring my every move, and I don't know who to trust anymore. This has been happening to me for about three months now.
Besides feeling watched, have you experienced any periods where your mood felt significantly lower or higher than usual, or where your energy levels shifted drastically?

No, I haven't really had any major highs or lows in my mood, and my energy has been pretty stable. My mood is mostly normal, other than the constant stress and anxiety I feel from being watched all the time. It's just the fear of being monitored that really gets to me.
Other than the feeling of being watched, have you ever heard voices that others cannot hear, or noticed anything unusual about your senses, such as seeing things that aren't there?

Yes, lately I've been hearing whispering voices when I'm alone, which has been really frightening. I've also occasionally seen shadowy figures out of the corner of my eye that disappear when I look. It's all started happening over the last few months and is making me very uneasy.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Delusional Disorder, Schizophrenia]. The patient's report of auditory hallucinations (whispering voices) and visual hallucinations (shadowy figures) in addition to the persecutory delusions indicates that the symptoms go beyond the criteria for Delusional Disorder, which excludes prominent hallucinations. Therefore, Schizophrenia is now the primary candidate.
